'''Allen Divers Allen's Star Destroyer''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Allen Divers]]
* '''Published:''' October 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Executor: Meditation Chamber]]
* '''Strategy:''' Allen's Star Destroyer
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Allen's Star Destroyer Divers DS.txt |Download]]
